Festivals in
Northern.

Festivals and cultural events kept here, in calendar order. Many dates move from year to year, so each festival’s page has what we know about when.

  • Lunar

    Bugum

    The Dagomba new-year fire festival: torches carried through the streets and out of town at night.

    The ninth day of Bugum Goli, the first lunar month (about late June in 2026)Yendi, Tamale and Dagbon

  • Lunar

    Damba

    Drumming, smocks and chiefs on horseback, in the month that marks the Prophet’s birth.

    The month of Damba, the third lunar month (about late August in 2026)Yendi, Tamale and the north
